# Wulin NPC Portrait Sources

The app NPC portraits are cropped and lightly color-adjusted from Wikimedia Commons public-domain or CC0 source media. The app-facing asset names remain stable under `FocusGuard/Assets.xcassets/WulinNpc*.imageset`.

## WulinNpcHermit
- App role: 독고은거자 / 무명의 오두막
- Source file: Chinese - Ancestor Portrait of an Aged Man Seated - Walters 3596.jpg
- Source page: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Chinese_-_Ancestor_Portrait_of_an_Aged_Man_Seated_-_Walters_3596.jpg
- Original media: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/2c/Chinese_-_Ancestor_Portrait_of_an_Aged_Man_Seated_-_Walters_3596.jpg
- License: Public domain (Public domain)
- Artist/author metadata: Anonymous (China)Unknown author
- Credit metadata: Walters Art Museum:  Home page  Info about artwork
